about: every application an MCP server from its semantic tree: typed operations with their openas effects, no tool code written
transactions, undo and dry_run as protocol operations, any application
actions only a person may take: refused to every request over the bus, whatever actor it names
an agent player at a declared human tier (reaction, rate, what it sees), its record replayed to the same checksum
a frame as SVG, every shape a group named by its node, what SVG cannot say a marked pixel island
topology-aligned morphs between shapes of different contour and hole counts, strokes and fills, CPU and GPU the same frames
fixed-point fighting kernel: 10,000 random-depth rollbacks byte-identical, extractable whole

needs: a physical GPU (NVIDIA, AMD or Apple)
a physical GPU (NVIDIA, AMD or Apple)
a 120 Hz display and a latency probe

about: any application's steps previewed before they are allowed: run unseen and taken back (no journal, no history, motion off), the pictures before and after and the semantic changes; a step that asks the person shown, not done
a pixel to the node that drew it, the nodes it sits in, and the line of the program that built each (ui_drew), headless
every omui page offers its operations as WebMCP tools where the browser has navigator.modelContext — no application code; what needs the person asked through the browser
an agent playtests a game headless at a person's tier, at many times real time, and reports where it is hard or tedious, each problem with a record that replays to the same bytes
